caption: A file read in a microkernel: system call in, message to the file server, reply back out — four mode switches and two message copies. The 20,000-line kernel is only 3.23% of the system's 620,000 lines; the monolithic kernel doing the same work is 5,000,000 lines, all privileged — 8.06 times larger.

spec.aria: A five-step flow of a microkernel file read: the client's system call enters the 20,000-line microkernel, a message goes to the user-mode 150,000-line file server, the reply returns through the kernel, and the kernel copies the data back to the client.
